name: 05_open_drawer_ego
title: Storing and Retrieving Tube from Drawer
summary: The robot opens a cabinet drawer, stores a green tube inside, looks away at a vase, turns back, and reopens the drawer to retrieve the tube.
robot: two black dexterous robotic hands and arms with wrist-mounted enclosures
setting: an office space with a wooden tabletop set above a white drawer unit

source.original_prompt: Pull open the drawer with the left arm

segments.instruction: Reach the left hand down toward the top left drawer knob while the camera tilts down slightly.
Pull open the top left drawer with the left hand while the camera stays on the cabinet.
Reach the right hand to the green tube on the tabletop and grasp it.
Place the green tube into the open drawer with the right hand and push the drawer closed with the left hand.
segments.memory_event: hide: green tube is concealed inside the closed top-left drawer

segments.instruction: Turn the head camera to the right to focus on the white vase on the table.
segments.memory_event: hide: central tabletop with charger, black device, and drawer cabinet leaves view

segments.instruction: Keep the camera focused on the vase while the right hand briefly hovers near it.
Turn the head camera back to the center facing the desk and drawers.
segments.memory_event: return: desk view returns with the white charger, black device, and closed drawers exactly as left

segments.instruction: Pull the top left drawer open again with the left hand and reach in with the right hand for what you put there.
segments.memory_event: return: top-left drawer reopens showing the green tube lying inside
